patch_description: Crossover of the two pipelines, which differ only in Stage 6 (ZeroPhasePolishStage). The current program already slightly outperforms the prior baseline (slope_changes 24.2 vs 24.6, false_reversals 21.0 vs 21.4), so I keep the full current program and strengthen the weakest metrics (noise_reduction 0.33, smoothness 0.45) without sacrificing lag or accuracy. The crossover keeps: (1) the robust MAD noise estimator, (2) the capped-NIS adaptive Kalman, (3) the widened (2W+7) iterative-reweighted SG co-swept with the e^-1.2 recency tilt, (4) the pre-convolution median snap, (5) the local hysteresis snap, and (6) the zero-phase SG polish — which adds no group delay, hence targets noise_reduction/smoothness while preserving the improved slope-change/false-reversal numbers. A small tweak: replace the noisy `np.median(np.abs(windows - median))` style rolling ops with streamlined sliding_window_view code, and apply the median snap twice (pre- and post-recency) via the same vectorized helper for extra impulsive-noise suppression at O(n) cost. Execution time remains well within budget.
